behavior: Only a complete original Queued/revision-0 record can be cancelled. Full-record atomic archive CAS arbitrates against Staging in SQLite and IndexedDB.
Cancellation proof is version 1/kind CANCELLED with a distinct purpose AAD bound to every raw record field and ciphertext. Legacy sent-completion envelope is unchanged.

Cancelled is archive-only: ordinary state DTO/updates cannot create it, pending observation excludes it, exact get authenticates it, and receipt lookup validates it then returns no delivery completion.
Permanent archive fences prevent an old insertion or frozen-draft retry from requeuing the same ID. Concurrent cancellers and lost archive responses resolve the same original decision.

Explicit use case captures the caller owner and full observed record, checks local admission before/after storage, retains expired-but-owned local access, and preserves confirmed denials/cancellation.
Queue replay of a cancelled original does not schedule. Stage returns an already-cancelled original before native acquisition; loss of the staging CAS prevents enqueue.
Real application SQLite/DI recovery after container restart clears only the exact frozen draft without sending its cancelled original; newer drafts and independent queued work remain intact.
